# braidworks path

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cli_docs.py from `braidworks --help`; do not edit by hand.
     Run `make cli-docs` after changing the command line. -->

Show the route between types without running it. For the task this serves, see the [how-to guides](../../how-to/).

```text
usage: braidworks path [-h] --from TYPE[,TYPE…] --to TYPE[,TYPE…] [--only WEAVERS]
                       [--policy {local_only,api_only,local_first,api_first}]

Show the route between types without running it.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --from TYPE[,TYPE…]
  --to TYPE[,TYPE…]
  --only WEAVERS
  --policy {local_only,api_only,local_first,api_first}
                        backend policy (default: local_first).

examples:
  braidworks path --from protein.query --to structure.pdb.ids
```
